description: Daemon invokes one registered plugin operation. Params: operation_id + interface + method (strings resolving to an admitted descriptor) + arguments (object). external_receipt-contract responses are {ok:bool, result:object, child_receipts:array} with NO plugin-authored external_receipt; the daemon injects the receipt
source: the AII OS BBB conformance vectors
checked_by: framing round-trip now; contract wrap/validation lands with the Go host worker

vectors.name: request
vectors.note: daemon uses string ids for plugin.invoke and caps the rendered frame at 1 MiB before sending

vectors.name: response_plugin_result_before_wrap
vectors.note: what the plugin sends: ok bool + result object + child_receipts array, and it MUST NOT include external_receipt (daemon rejects); C dispatch helpers emit exactly this shape

vectors.name: response_after_daemon_wrap
vectors.note: the daemon injects the host-authored receipt into the plugin's result before crediting it upstream (further receipt fields elided)

vectors.name: response_plugin_failure
vectors.note: failure reason/reason_code are read from inside result.result

vectors.name: response_error_method_not_found
vectors.note: C dispatch shape for an unregistered method (the Go SDK serve loop diverges: -32601 for ANY handler error, no data)

vectors.name: invalid_arguments_not_object
vectors.note: the daemon-side contract module refuses to build a service request from this; a conforming host never emits it

vectors.name: invalid_plugin_response_with_self_authored_receipt
vectors.note: plugin text is data, a host-authored receipt is proof: a self-vouched receipt is rejected outright
